summary: This image presents a template-based interface designed to assist users in understanding planning tasks. It consists of two parts: the first part lists various suggested questions related to resolving conflicts among goals, such as 'What are the conflicts between my goals?' and 'How can I prioritize my goals?' The second part illustrates an interactive chat where the system explains why a specific task is unsolvable due to conflicting goals among family members, providing examples like 'Parent cooks dinner and Parent goes to the basketball game.' The interface aims to help users navigate their planning challenges by suggesting specific actions to resolve conflicts and prioritize goals effectively.
